_doc: 2026 car / machine registry (Car Explorer tech source). Every fact carries a source. scope: car_specific = this team's car/supplier choice; regulation = a general 2026 F1 rule the team also publishes (never present it as a team-specific spec). Unknown = absent. No horsepower or unpublished performance figures.

specs.label: Steering
